plan.title: perf(release,reconcile): apply-lifecycle-fixes still does one REST call per anchored issue

narratives.Description: perf(release,reconcile): apply-lifecycle-fixes still does one REST call per anchored issue
narratives.Overview:
## Recut of the filed body

Body alignment to the bound arc. Not a new target. Do not restamp `design-critique:mechanism-shaped`.

Bound by successor lean 5590854039, verified-claims table 5590921871, and synthesis 5590925030 (dispatch SHA `37c306e8c223d0eb5231acc400ac4a07b64b4521`). That arc accepted F1-F3 (blocking and sharpening) and recorded F4-F5 as footnotes. `## Repairs` maps each heading to a row. The original "reuse the #3752 inventory, treat absence as non-open" contract is withdrawn.

This rewrite is a bootstrap so current ingest can harvest this issue. It does not restamp. It does not open a recut arc.

## Parent

#4265

## Problem, restated against the tree

`task reconcile:issues -- --apply-lifecycle-fixes` still walks one REST GET per anchored issue. On the v0.113.0 cut that was 1496 lifecycle anchors, 1261 unique numbers, ~18 minutes of silence, then moved=0, already-terminal=1425.

Release Step 3 already loads one paginated REST inventory (#3752) and maps presence to OPEN and absence to NOT_FOUND with a null `stateReason`. The operator apply path in `reconcileMain` unions every lifecycle-folder anchor into `needed`, then `fetchIssueStates` loops `fetchOneIssueStateRest`. `applyLifecycleFixes` skips completed/cancelled paths after that fetch. The skip does not shrink the GET set.

The #3752 inventory is enough to know which anchors are still open. It is not enough to choose completed versus cancelled. `destinationFolder` uses `state_reason` (NOT_PLANNED / DUPLICATE -> cancelled, else completed). Inventory absence is `IssueState("NOT_FOUND")` with null reason, which always files completed. Copying Step 3's unconfirmed absence into a path that writes and `git mv`s briefs would mis-file not_planned and duplicate issues.

Orphan-active (#3767) already reuses the same inventory and confirms absence with one live GET before acting. Apply is a stronger consumer.

## What to build

1. Shrink the fetch set to non-terminal anchors before any network. Already-terminal briefs (completed/, cancelled/) are not live-fetched unless a mismatch actually requires state.

2. Use the #3752 open-issue inventory for OPEN status. Fail closed on truncated or malformed inventory, same as Step 3.

3. Live REST GET only for the remaining non-open, non-terminal candidates that would actually move, so `state_reason` is known and `destinationFolder` can choose completed versus cancelled. Reuse one live result when several briefs name the same issue.

4. Print progress (N/total or equivalent) on that remaining work so a long run cannot look hung.

5. A fixture or test locks: no per-issue loop over a >1 inventory for OPEN status; destination for a not_planned/duplicate closed issue is cancelled, not completed.

6. CHANGELOG entry.

7. task check passes.

## Type

AFK

## Blocked by

None -- can start immediately after ingest.

## Rejected

- Wholesale `fetchIssueStatesForRelease` as the whole apply contract (no `state_reason`)
- Treating inventory absence as sufficient for `destinationFolder`
- Restoring GraphQL batching (#954)
- Recutting #3752
- Fetching already-terminal briefs "just in case" when no mismatch requires state

## Acceptance

- [ ] `--apply-lifecycle-fixes` does not issue one REST GET per anchored issue when an open-issue inventory is available (OPEN status comes from the inventory)
- [ ] Already-terminal briefs (completed/, cancelled/) are not live-fetched unless a mismatch actually requires state
- [ ] Non-open non-terminal movers receive a live REST `state_reason`; NOT_PLANNED and DUPLICATE go to cancelled/, other closed go to completed/
- [ ] Progress is printed (N/total or equivalent) on the remaining work
- [ ] A fixture or test locks the inventory OPEN path (no per-issue loop on a >1 inventory) and the cancelled-versus-completed destination
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry
- [ ] task check passes

## Non-goals

- Do not recut #3752
- Do not restore GraphQL
- Do not restamp this issue for a second arc
- Do not implement #4258 here (Recut-lean ingest harvest). This body recut is so current harvest can read these AC checkboxes
- Occupancy CLI flag (#4266), npm sibling wait (#4267), win32 body-file closeout (#4268)

## Repairs (accepted headings -> this body)

| Heading | Class | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Inventory absence has no state_reason; apply would file every move as completed | blocks-the-design | Problem restated; What to build 3; Acceptance live `state_reason`; Rejected wholesale Step 3 substitute |
| #3767 already refused unconfirmed absence for a weaker consumer | sharpens-framing | Problem restated; What to build 2-3 (inventory for OPEN, live GET for movers) |
| Skipping terminal live-fetch is a fetch-set shrink, not an inventory property | sharpens-framing | What to build 1; Acceptance already-terminal bullet |
| Progress during fetch | footnote | What to build 4; Acceptance progress |
| GraphQL batching | footnote | Rejected; Non-goals |

## Related

- #3752 -- open-issue inventory (do not recut)
- #3767 -- inventory absence confirmed by one live GET
- #954 -- REST, not GraphQL
- #4258 -- Recut-lean ingest harvest; this recut is the body-alignment workaround, not that mapper
- #4265 -- parent tracker
